notes: Two versions of one isnad: the dashed gloss gives Haroun's line («حدثني ابن أبي ذباب» in his version) and Ishaq's («حدثني الحارث»), so each is its own group, both ending at the same Companion
«مولى أبي هريرة» is the patron of عبد الرحمن بن مهران, not a link; the link is occurrence 2 of «أبي هريرة»
